name: account-password-set-racing-disable

graded_by.test: owed: Provider pauses administrator set-password after precomputation before state check-and-set, commits a competing disable, then resumes password set. Transactional state check must prevent replacing the voided hash; disabled record retains empty hash, no successful password-set audit or login survives. Exercise opposite ordering too: completed password set is subsequently voided by disable.
